title: Franchise, Products & Partnerships: Creative and Product Design & Development Internships – Summer 2027
note: Tracks include Franchise Creative (character illustration), Toys & Hardlines (toy and plush design) and Toys Packaging; applications open Nov 9 – Dec 4 and may close early.

facts.summary: Paid 10-week summer internship in NBCU's consumer products and theme-park merchandise group, with placements in creative, toy and packaging design.
facts.duties: Depending on placement: character art and style-guide content, toy and plush concept sketches and Illustrator art, packaging concepts and mood boards, trend research.
facts.requirements: Enrolled in a degree program for the whole internship (Spring 2027 grads not eligible), sophomore or above, US work authorization without sponsorship, 40 hrs/week on-site; Illustrator/Photoshop, sketching, 3D tools preferred.
facts.apply: Apply on SmartRecruiters with a one-page resume, cover letter naming areas of interest, and unofficial transcript.
